messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, Elections, and Economic systems and development in Germany during the 1990s, matching this research need: Representative daily telephone survey data from 1991 onward on eligible voters’ political preferences, party and candidate support, attitudes on political and social issues, and past election voting behavior.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Germany Politbarometer 1991 daily telephone survey eligible voters political preferences candidate past vote dataset
GESIS Politbarometer 1991 daily telephone interviews cumulative dataset
